newsitem.title: USA: Urban to buy interest in two properties.
newsitem.headline: Urban to buy interest in two properties.

text.p: Urban Shopping Centers Inc said Wednesday it has reached agrements to acquire interests in properties in Boston and San Francisco for a total of $73.3 million.

In one deal, Urban said it will pay $31 million in cash for 50 percent preferred interest in San Francisco Centre, a vertical shopping mall, with the deal structured for Urban to acquire the remaining interest in aobut eight years.
A private investor group headed by H. Patrick Hackett Jr. and Okla Basil Meade Jr. will own the remaining interest in the property until then.
Urban Retail Properties Co, the property management affiliate of Urban, will assume leasing and management responsibilities at the property at closing, Urban said.
Under a separate agreement, Urban plans to purchase a one-third equity interest in Copley Place, a mixed use property in Boston, from JMB Realty Corp, in a transaction valued at $42.3 million.
Urban said it will issue 1,282,828 units of partnership interest in Urban Shopping Centers LP valued at $33 per unit.
The remaining interest in the property is owned by Overseas Partners Capital Corp, a unit of Overseas Partners Ltd, a Bermuda based reinsurance company, Urban said.
Urban shares closed up 3/8 at 30-1/4 Wednesday.
